result: For EVERY complex rank-four Bob map K:C^5->C^4 with kernel line in span{|0>,|4>}, the actual normalized local compression of the specified PPT/SN3 grid state has SN<=2; it has SN=2 unless the kernel is span{|0>}. The same statement holds for kernel lines in span{|2>,|3>}, with possible exception span{|2>}, by the explicitly verified local symmetry. This is a proper family of 4x4 PPT states, not a global theorem or target witness.
state_and_source: Use R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[F]+[G]+[I]+[H]), where A=|00>+|11>+|22>, B=|01>+|12>, D=|10>-|21>, C=|02>+|34>, E=|20>+|33>, F=|23>, G=|30>, I=|32>, H=|04>. The exact PPT/SN3 certificate for R/31 is in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9. Its range is the published Eq.11 of https://arxiv.org/html/2509.07086v1. This reproduces a known 4x5 possibility; no novelty/priority claim.
local_map: Up to an invertible output filter, K sends original Bob |0>->u|0>, |4>->v|0>, fixes |1>,|2>, and sends |3>->|3>, for arbitrary complex (u,v)!=(0,0). This normal form applies to any rank-four K with kernel in the indicated plane because the common image line of 0,4 is independent of the images of 1,2,3. Let primes denote images under I tensor K.
explicit_sr2_decomposition: For z in {1,i,-1,-i} set q_z=z A'+z^2 B'-D'+z^3 C'. Its coefficient column 2 equals z times column 1 and column 3 is zero; thus SR(q_z)<=2 for all complex u,v. Distinct fourth-root phase powers give (1/4)sum_z[q_z]=[A']+[B']+[D']+[C']. Hence R_uv=(1/4)sum_z[q_z]+2[C']+3([E']+[F']+[G']+[I']+[H']), an exact nonnegative sum of SR<=2 projectors. PPT is inherited by local congruence: R_uv^Gamma=(I tensor conjugate(K))R^Gamma(I tensor conjugate(K))^*.
entanglement_for_u_nonzero: Project Alice and Bob onto output labels 0,1,2. The resulting 3x3 positive operator is T=[u00+11+22]+[01+12]+[u10-21]+3[02]+3|u|^2[20]+3|v|^2[00]. Its range is contained in the six-dimensional matrix space M=[[u*a+h,b,c],[u*d,a,b],[e,-d,a]], with unique coefficients a,b,c,d,e,h. The two rank-one minors a^2+bd and u(a^2-bd)+a*h imply a(h+2u*a)=0. Thus every product vector in this range satisfies a*conjugate(h)=-2*conjugate(u)*|a|^2. For ANY separable decomposition, summing gives coefficient covariance C_ah=-2*conjugate(u) C_aa. But the displayed T has C_ah=0 and C_aa=1: its first projector has a=1,h=0 and every other displayed projector has a=0. For u!=0 this is a contradiction, so T and its 4x4 parent are entangled. Consequently SN=2. This stronger covariance argument handles v!=0, where a simple rank-one range-spanning test alone is insufficient. For u=0 no exact entanglement claim is made.
reflection: The exact local symmetry recorded and entrywise verified in frontier-20261028-grid-mixed-zero-three-compressions-v1.json SHA256 25278f1e460330954c54de872f9468b880fa3f3220dbab6c15954852cb139789 maps Bob |0> to -|2> and |4> to -|3> while preserving R, so it transfers the entire theorem to span{|2>,|3>} and sends the only possible exceptional endpoint to span{|2>}.

verification.observed: Five exact Gaussian-rational inputs (u,v)=(1,0),(0,1),(1,2),(1+i,1-i),(i,3): each checked all four phase vectors by all sixteen 3x3 rank minors and all 256 projected state entries, with zero mismatches. No floating arithmetic was used.
verification.scope: These finite checks do not establish the all-complex theorem, which follows from the displayed column identity, phase twirl and covariance proof. No independent external or formal review is claimed.

combined_boundary: Together with the prior last-two-coordinate kernel family and the zero-three/two-four families, this covers four mixed-coordinate CP1 families, the last-two CP1 family, and any kernel line in span{|0>,|1>,|2>} (there the only rank-three generator A loses Schmidt rank and the defining sum is already SR<=2). The mixed planes span{|1>,|3>} and span{|1>,|4>}, general kernel lines mixing more coordinates, arbitrary 4x4 PPT states and the exact exceptional endpoints remain open here.
